issue.title: ACE Patch pane: 'o' is double-booked, so mark_pr_origin shadows cycle_grouping_mode and forward grouping-cycle is unreachable
issue.description:
docs/ace.md:614 and the Patch info panel both promise that 'o'/'O' cycle the Patch grouping mode forward/reverse (BY_PROJECT -> BY_DATE -> BY_STATUS). Only 'O' works. 'o' opens the PR-origin modal instead.

ROOT CAUSE
src/sase/ace/tui/keymaps/metadata.py binds two app actions to the same default key:
  index  27: ('mark_pr_origin', 'Mark PR Origin', False)
  index 154: ('cycle_grouping_mode', 'Cycle Grouping', False)
Both default to 'o' in src/sase/default_config.yml (mark_pr_origin: "o", cycle_grouping_mode: "o") and both have priority=False. build_app_bindings() preserves _BINDING_META order, and Textual's App._check_bindings (textual 8.0.1, app.py:3905-3915) walks key_to_bindings[key] in insertion order and stops at the first binding whose run_action succeeds. mark_pr_origin is enabled on the whole Artifacts tab (_app_action_availability.py:172-174: only blocks current_tab != ARTIFACTS_TAB), so it always wins on the Patch pane and cycle_grouping_mode is never reached. The other two 'o' bindings (beads_open_bug, files_open_external) are pane-gated and correctly inert on Patches.

REPRODUCTION (executed on master e4baf0771, workspace sase_12)
  from sase.ace.tui.keymaps import load_keymap_registry
  from sase.ace.tui.keymaps.bindings import build_app_bindings
  reg = load_keymap_registry({})
  [(b.action, b.priority) for b in build_app_bindings(reg.app) if b.key == 'o']
  -> [('mark_pr_origin', False), ('beads_open_bug', False),
      ('files_open_external', False), ('cycle_grouping_mode', False)]
  [(b.action, b.priority) for b in build_app_bindings(reg.app) if b.key == 'O']
  -> [('cycle_grouping_mode_reverse', False)]

IMPACT
Forward grouping-cycle is unreachable on the Patch pane; users must press 'O' twice to advance one step. action_cycle_grouping_mode's Patch arm (actions/agents/_grouping.py:248-262) is dead code from the keyboard. src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/patch_info_panel.py:198 renders the '[group: <label>]' badge using key_display_name(app.cycle_grouping_mode), so the UI advertises a key that does not work.

SCOPE
Decide which action moves. Options: move mark_pr_origin behind the bang-mode prefix ('!o'), give it a distinct default key, or scope its availability so it only claims 'o' when it is contextually meaningful. Then update src/sase/default_config.yml, docs/ace.md (Navigation and PR Actions tables), the help modal (modals/help_modal/patches_bindings.py:71,251), and add a regression test asserting that no two app-level bindings share a default key while both being enabled on the same tab/pane.

NOTE
Found while researching the Artifacts pane contract unification (sase/repos/research/202608/unified_artifacts_pane_contract.md, section 1.3). Not caused by that work.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-jf — also an ACE keymap default-key collision (the 'minus' key colliding with collapse_panel_folds). Different keys and different root cause (that one surfaced through a registry-loading test; this one is silent because Textual's first-enabled-binding-wins dispatch hides it), but a fix here should consider whether the regression test proposed in SCOPE would also have caught sase-jf.
